title: Adusa Sarbat
description: Adusa Sarbat (Vasaka Syrup) is a potent therapeutic syrup prepared from Adusa (Vasaka/Malabar Nut), highly valued for its strong respiratory actions. This classical formulation acts as a powerful expectorant liquefying thick mucus. Relieves chronic cough through expectoration support. Addresses asthma through airway opening. Treats bronchitis. Clears respiratory congestion.
dosage: 10–20 ml mixed with an equal amount of lukewarm water, taken twice a day after meals
